item.title: USDA corrige los datos sobre el maíz de septiembre debido a un "error de procesamiento"
item.description: El Departamento de Agricultura de EEUU (USDA) informó el viernes que ha corregido los datos sobre el maíz que publicó en septiembre después de que un "error de procesamiento" afectara a las previsiones de rendimiento y producción del país.
item.dc:creator: Tom Polansek
item.content:encoded: El Departamento de Agricultura de EEUU (USDA) informó el viernes que ha corregido los datos sobre el maíz que publicó en septiembre después de que un "error de procesamiento" afectara a las previsiones de rendimiento y producción del país. El USDA se ha visto sometido al escrutinio de los comerciantes de cereales, analistas y economistas en cuanto a la fiabilidad de sus estimaciones de cosechas debido a una serie de errores en los datos. La agencia, considerada desde hace tiempo como la referencia por excelencia en materia de información sobre el mercado agrícola mundial, había afirmado anteriormente que estaba tratando de mejorar las estimaciones de cosechas. El Servicio Nacional de Estadísticas Agrícolas (NASS) del USDA descubrió el error tras surgir inquietudes sobre un informe de cosechas de este mes que preveía que los agricultores estadounidenses cosecharían más bushels de maíz de lo esperado inicialmente, según el comunicado. La previsión de cosecha, superior a lo esperado, provocó una caída de los futuros del maíz estadounidense. "El NASS detectó un error de procesamiento que afectó a las densidades de siembra de maíz de septiembre, al recuento de mazorcas, a los rendimientos y a la producción en Kansas y Nebraska", sostuvo el comunicado. "El error también afectó a los promedios de 10 estados correspondientes a septiembre en cuanto a densidades de plantación y recuento de mazorcas, así como a las previsiones de rendimiento y producción de maíz en EEUU". Un informe corregido que el USDA publicó en su página web mostraba un rendimiento del maíz en septiembre de 178,8 bushels por acre. El mes pasado, el USDA indicó que su estimación del rendimiento para septiembre era de 178,5 bushels por acre. El USDA revisó su estimación de producción de septiembre a 15.828 millones de bushels, frente a la estimación original de septiembre de 15.800 millones. Las previsiones de cosechas para octubre se revisaron, se validaron y no han variado, informó el USDA.

item.title: PHP Foundation 'under-funded' with one full-time staff member, director says
item.description: The discovery of two serious flaws in PHP this week set off a global scramble to keep websites safe from hackers, showing just how critical the three-decade-old open-source programming language is to the internet.
item.dc:creator: Toby Sterling
item.content:encoded: The discovery of two serious flaws in PHP this week set off a global scramble to keep websites [USN:L1N468095 TEXT:"safe from hackers, "]showing just how critical the three-decade-old open-source programming language is to the internet. Yet the nonprofit foundation that supports PHP, which may underpin up to 70% of sites globally, operates on a shoestring budget. “We have one full-time staff member (that's me) and 14 mostly part-time contractors,” Executive Director Elizabeth Barron of the PHP Foundation said via email in an interview on Friday. Board members are unpaid volunteers, and funding comes from donations and grants. The foundation works with outside researchers and companies, including OpenAI and cybersecurity firms Wiz and Calif, to investigate security flaws and coordinate fixes, including Wednesday's patches. While Web security company Cloudflare has reported millions of hacking attempts, Barron said the foundation had no evidence hackers were able to exploit the vulnerabilities before they were disclosed, or on sites that have been patched. "We received no further indication from OpenAI, Wiz or Calif, with whom we're working closely on this issue, regarding any issues on patched systems,” she said. Artificial intelligence has proved both a help and a burden to the foundation. It helped researchers find the flaws, which had been present for a decade, and Barron said it made programmers more efficient. However, it is also increasing maintainers' workloads. The PHP project is receiving nearly twice as many proposed code changes as a year ago, “yet the number of contributors hasn't doubled,” she said. Reviewing contributions and bug reports requires “a massive amount of human input and experience.” Recent events have shown how heavily companies and governments rely on PHP, Barron said. “Given that reliance, it is clear that PHP is incredibly under-funded.”

item.title: Líder norcoreano Kim aboga por una "revolución militar", pide que se refuercen las unidades del ejército
item.description: El líder norcoreano Kim Jong Un instó a que las compañías del ejército del país se conviertan en unidades de combate de élite y autosuficientes durante una reunión de dos días de los comandantes de compañía celebrada en Pyongyang, informó el sábado la agencia estatal de noticias KCNA.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El líder norcoreano Kim Jong Un instó a que las compañías del ejército del país se conviertan en unidades de combate de élite y autosuficientes durante una reunión de dos días de los comandantes de compañía celebrada en Pyongyang, informó el sábado la agencia estatal de noticias KCNA. El evento puso de relieve la prioridad política constante de Kim de fortalecer el ejército. En un discurso en una conferencia de comandantes de compañía del Ejército el 22 y 23 de octubre —que, según KCNA, fue la primera de todo el ejército desde el IX Congreso del partido gobernante de Corea del Norte celebrado en febrero—, Kim instó a todas las compañías a prepararse a fondo para que se pueda alcanzar "el objetivo del refuerzo militar de la nueva era". "Construyamos el ejército más fuerte y aceleremos una revolución militar a nuestra manera", afirmó Kim. Durante el IX Congreso del partido gobernante de Corea del Norte de febrero, en el que se estableció la dirección del país para los próximos cinco años, Kim abogó por unas fuerzas armadas convencionales más fuertes, al tiempo que reafirmó los esfuerzos para desarrollar armas nucleares y misiles.

item.title: Alguns parisienses compram spray de pimenta e gás lacrimogêneo, alegando legítima defesa antes de protestos
item.description: Os parisienses estão comprando cartuchos de gás lacrimogêneo e sprays de pimenta para se defenderem e protegerem seus bens durante os protestos, que devem continuar ao longo do fim de semana, disse à Reuters o proprietário de uma loja de armas na capital francesa.
item.dc:creator: Elizabeth Howcroft, Ardee Napolitano
item.content:encoded: Os parisienses estão comprando cartuchos de gás lacrimogêneo e sprays de pimenta para se defenderem e protegerem seus bens durante os protestos, que devem continuar ao longo do fim de semana, disse à Reuters o proprietário de uma loja de armas na capital francesa. A França foi atingida pelo pior levante social dos últimos anos no último fim de semana, quando protestos em todo o país contra os altos preços e a deterioração dos serviços públicos se transformaram em tumultos. Uma prefeitura foi incendiada, lojas foram saqueadas e prédios cobertos de pichações, enquanto grupos violentos entraram em confronto com a polícia em cidades por todo o país. A polícia autorizou apenas uma manifestação sindical em Paris no sábado, rejeitando os pedidos de manifestações apresentados pela principal união estudantil da França, a Unef, e pelo movimento antissistema dos Coletes Amarelos. Na loja de armas Armurerie de la Bourse, no centro de Paris, o proprietário Yves Gollety disse à Reuters que observou um grande aumento nas vendas de armas não letais desde o fim de semana. Lojas a apenas 30 metros de distância foram saqueadas, com suas persianas arrancadas, disse ele. “É a primeira vez que vemos um aumento desse tipo, e em todos os segmentos da população”, disse Gollety, acrescentando que entre seus clientes estão lojistas, donos de restaurantes e pessoas físicas. “As pessoas ficaram traumatizadas fisicamente e estão com medo”, disse ele. Os produtos mais vendidos são sprays de pimenta e cartuchos de gás lacrimogêneo, que, segundo Gollety, só podem ser usados em legítima defesa. Gollety, que também é presidente da associação nacional de armeiros, disse ao jornal francês Le Parisien que os pedidos aumentaram dez vezes. O público em geral só tem permissão para comprar pequenos recipientes com menos de 100 mililitros, disse Gollety. A Reuters não encontrou evidências de que as pessoas em Paris estivessem comprando outros tipos de armas em resposta aos protestos. Alain Di Crescenzo, presidente da Câmara de Comércio da França, pediu aos lojistas que se abstivessem de usar armas para defender seus negócios. Em entrevista à emissora de rádio Europe 1 nesta sexta-feira, ele disse ter visto pessoalmente lojistas se armando com tacos de beisebol, pés-de-cabra e espingardas. A Reuters não conseguiu verificar essa informação de forma independente. “É extremamente preocupante”, disse ele. “Não é função deles fazer isso... Isso só aumentaria o sofrimento.” “A polícia deve ter liberdade para fazer seu trabalho, e recomendo a máxima cautela”, acrescentou. “É PRECISO ESTAR PREPARADO” Um lojista que vende motos e scooters no 15º arrondissement de Paris disse à Reuters que comprou três grandes cartuchos de gás lacrimogêneo, além de outro menor, para proteger sua loja. “Você pode ser pego de surpresa, com pessoas chegando sem qualquer aviso prévio. Por isso, é preciso estar preparado”, disse o lojista, que pediu para não ser identificado. O governo francês prometeu reforçar a segurança e mobilizará 70 mil policiais, apoiados por unidades especializadas, para os protestos de sábado, mas o aumento no número de pessoas pensando em como se defender ilustra os temores dos parisienses à medida que o fim de semana se aproxima. Um homem que visitava a loja de Gollety, um funcionário do setor financeiro de 58 anos que não quis se identificar, disse que havia pesquisado opções de autodefesa, embora, no fim das contas, não tivesse comprado nada nessa ocasião. “Considerando o que aconteceu na semana passada e o risco de isso se repetir no próximo fim de semana, prefiro ser sensato e me proteger”, disse ele, acrescentando que há muito tempo tem uma sensação de insegurança. “Venho pensando nisso há muito tempo e acho que vou tomar algumas medidas”, disse ele. Em outra parte de Paris, Yvan Weiss, dono de uma empresa de consultoria financeira, disse à Reuters que estava tomando medidas para evitar que as vitrines de sua empresa fossem quebradas. Questionado se considerava adquirir spray de pimenta ou outro equipamento de defesa, ele disse que havia pensado nisso, mas que, no fim, decidiu instalar persianas metálicas automáticas na fachada de sua loja.

item.title: Allegiant exercises options for six Boeing 737 MAX jets worth over $720 million
item.description: Allegiant Air said on Friday it had exercised options to buy six Boeing 737-8 aircraft under a 2021 purchase agreement with the planemaker.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Allegiant Air (ALGT.O) said on Friday it had exercised options to buy six Boeing (BA.N) 737-8 aircraft under a 2021 purchase agreement with the planemaker. The jets, scheduled for delivery in 2028, have a combined list price of more than $720 million, the company said. Allegiant has 56 firm aircraft under the agreement, including 22 already delivered, while purchase options remain for another 74 jets. Based on delivery year, the estimated market value of the planes is about $351 million, according to aviation analytics consultancy firm IBA.

item.title: North Korea's Kim calls for 'military revolution' as he urges stronger army units
item.description: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un called for the country's army companies to be turned into elite, self-sufficient combat units during a two-day meeting of company commanders in Pyongyang, state media KCNA said on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un called for the country's army companies to be turned into elite, self-sufficient combat units during a two-day meeting of company commanders in Pyongyang, state media KCNA said on Saturday. The event underscored Kim's consistent policy priority of strengthening the military. In a speech at a conference of company commanders for North Korea's Army on October 22-23, which KCNA said was the first military-wide gathering since the Ninth Congress of North Korea's ruling party in February, Kim called for every company to fully prepare so that "the goal of the new-era military build-up" can be achieved. "Let us build the strongest army and speed up a military revolution in our style", Kim said. During the [USN:L1N3ZL1I9 TEXT:"Ninth Congress"] of North Korea's ruling party in February, which sets the country's direction for the next five years, Kim called for stronger conventional armed forces as well as reaffirming efforts to develop nuclear weapons and missiles.

item.title: Pentagon designates Confucius Institutes in US a national security threat
item.description: The US Defense Department has designated Chinese-funded cultural centers on university campuses known as Confucius Institutes as a threat to US national security, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US Defense Department has designated Chinese-funded cultural centers on university campuses known as Confucius Institutes as a threat to US national security, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said on Friday. Washington has long accused Confucius Institutes of being Chinese propaganda tools and has taken steps to crack down on them. Hegseth, in a video posted on social media, alleged that Confucius Institutes were operating under disguise at US universities and that the Pentagon had added them to its list of institutions that threaten US national security. "It turns out that 80 new propaganda cells across 30 universities had popped up using different names and different charters, but with the same mission: to steal intellectual property and to infiltrate the minds of American students," Hegseth said. The Defense Department over the past two months has "systematically dismantled every single one of these organizations," he said. The Chinese embassy in Washington did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

item.title: Nigeria Ebola case linked to virus found in Kenya index case, health minister says
item.description: Genomic analysis of Nigeria's only confirmed Ebola case shows the virus is closely related to the strain detected in Kenya's index case, Nigeria's health minister Muhammad Ali Pate said on Friday, offering the first genetic link between the outbreaks.
item.dc:creator: Camillus Eboh, George Obulutsa
item.content:encoded: Genomic analysis of Nigeria's only confirmed Ebola case shows the virus is closely related to the strain detected in Kenya's index case, Nigeria's health minister Muhammad Ali Pate said on Friday, offering the first genetic link between the outbreaks. Nigerian authorities said there is no evidence that the Kenya index case traveled to Nigeria or had a direct connection to the Nigerian case. Pate said contacts linked to the case are being traced, quarantined and tested, with some results negative and others still pending Nigeria has recorded only one confirmed Ebola case from a traveller who had visited Uganda Uganda, which borders the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and has previously battled Ebola outbreaks, said on Friday it remained Ebola-free but was tightening precautions Uganda's health ministry said traveller locator forms had been reinstated for all arrivals, regardless of country of origin Uganda said travellers with a history of travel to the DRC, where the outbreak began, will not be permitted to transit the country

item.title: Colombia canjea deuda interna por 3.234 millones de dólares
item.description: El Ministerio de Hacienda de Colombia informó el viernes que realizó un canje de títulos de deuda pública interna por 10,3 billones de pesos (3.234 millones de dólares), para extender los vencimientos y reducir la presión de pagos a corto plazo ante las dificultades fiscales del país.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Ministerio de Hacienda de Colombia informó el viernes que realizó un canje de títulos de deuda pública interna por 10,3 billones de pesos (3.234 millones de dólares), para extender los vencimientos y reducir la presión de pagos a corto plazo ante las dificultades fiscales del país. En la operación, el Gobierno recogió títulos de deuda pública interna TES con vencimiento entre noviembre de 2026 y noviembre de 2027, y a cambio entregó papeles con plazos entre 2029 y 2062, precisó el Ministerio en un comunicado. Se trata del segundo de tres canjes de deuda pública local que el Gobierno planea realizar antes de finalizar el año. En el anterior canje, realizado a inicios de octubre, el Gobierno intercambió títulos por 19,8 billones de pesos (6.217 millones de dólares). Los TES son la segunda fuente de financiación interna del gasto público, después del recaudo de impuestos. Según el Ministerio de Hacienda, el tercer canje se realizará el 19 de noviembre. "Con esta operación el Gobierno Nacional alcanza un monto total canjeado de 30,1 billones de pesos, lo que representa una disminución del 50% en los vencimientos de 2026 y de 19% para los vencimientos en 2027, logrando una reducción de amortizaciones de 3,9 billones de pesos este año y de 26,2 billones el próximo", explicó el Ministerio de Hacienda. El Gobierno del presidente Abelardo De La Espriella anunció en agosto cambios en el presupuesto de gastos de 2026, que establecen un endeudamiento adicional de 35 billones de pesos (10.989 millones de dólares) este año, para cubrir el pronóstico del déficit fiscal, que aumentó a un 7,2% del PIB desde una meta previa de 5,3%. (1 dólar = 3.185,01 pesos)

item.title: In Florida, Trump vows to deal with Cuba after Iran gets settled
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Friday used a campaign rally in Florida, where Cuban Americans are a potent voting bloc, to vow to address his concerns about Cuba once the Iran war is settled.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Maria Cardona, Steve Holland
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump on Friday used a campaign rally in Florida, where Cuban Americans are a potent voting bloc, to vow to address his concerns about Cuba once the Iran war is settled. In a 90-minute speech in Fort Myers, Trump repeated more military action against Iran may lie ahead as he tries to address the causes of a spike in oil prices that has put Republicans on the defensive ahead of the November 3 midterm elections . With an eye toward the senior Americans who live in Florida, Trump said he planned to spend $250 million to hire at least 5,000 new nurses in elder care facilities all across America. While the Iran war has no end in sight, Trump talked tough about Cuba, part of a pattern of putting pressure on the communist government there after ousting the leader of Venezuela early this year. Trump, who won 68% of the Cuban American vote in Florida in the 2024 election, said American naval forces from Iran will stop at Cuba on the way home. "We'll have one of them stop about 50 yards off the coast. They'll raise up their hands, and then we're going to send Marco Rubio in to finish up the deal," he said. Secretary of State Rubio, a former US senator from Florida, has been handling much of the Cuba-related policy for Trump. "To those who seek to create positive change in Cuba - now is the time," Rubio said on X on Friday, urging those disappointed by Cuba's government "to create the change you desire through a discrete partnership with the CIA." His post did not elaborate. Trump's rally was intended to boost the electoral prospects of Florida Republican Representative Byron Donalds, who is running for governor against Democrat David Jolly. His speech, the latest in a near-daily blitz of campaign rallies in largely friendly areas, rambled from topic to topic such as the size of his crowds and his White House renovations. Trump has increased pressure on Cuba in his second term. In September, he labeled Cuba a "failed state" at the UN General Assembly and said, "Freedom will be coming to Cuba," prompting a walkout by the Cuban delegation. Trump has openly stated that his goal is to fundamentally change Cuba's government. A US-imposed oil blockade has put the country under severe strain as it contends with fuel shortages and blackouts exacerbated by failing infrastructure. UN human rights experts have condemned the oil blockade as a violation of international law while rights advocates say the Trump administration's threats have echoed an [USN:L4N3YE036 TEXT:"imperialist approach"].

item.title: Russia, Ukraine agree on ceasefire in embattled town, to hold peace talks next month
item.description: Ukraine and Russia said on Friday they had agreed on a ceasefire in the Russian-occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky, brokered through US first lady Melania Trump, and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said peace negotiators would meet next month for new talks.
item.dc:creator: Steve Holland, Yuliia Dysa
item.content:encoded: Ukraine and Russia said on Friday they had agreed on a [USN:L1N4690MZ TEXT:"ceasefire"] in the Russian-occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky, brokered through US first lady Melania Trump, and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said [USN:L1N4690TJ TEXT:"peace negotiators"] would meet next month for new talks. The two sides said the ceasefire would go into effect on October 27, allowing the delivery of aid and the evacuation of residents through humanitarian corridors. Amid a US push to organise new talks aimed at ending the 4-1/2-year-old war, Zelenskiy said negotiators from Ukraine, Russia and the United States had agreed to technical-level meetings in the first half of November in Abu Dhabi. A US official later said the three countries may hold their next talks in a couple weeks in Abu Dhabi or Switzerland. Zelenskiy said he hoped a meeting of the countries' leaders would follow. The peace efforts follow a rift between Washington and Kyiv in recent weeks and a series of moves by US President Donald Trump seen as favouring Russia. A major source of friction was limitations placed on the Starlink communication system that Ukraine uses to protect against incoming attacks. Trump [USN:L6N4690ZQ TEXT:"said on Friday"] that if Ukraine still faced a problem accessing the system, he would straighten it out and, if necessary, speak about the matter to SpaceX (SPCX.O) CEO Elon Musk. In the town of Oleshky, occupied by Russian forces since February 2022, residents have reported that they faced a deepening food crisis. "Both nations agreed to temporarily stop all military action in Oleshky to allow for humanitarian aid to enter and to prepare a civilian evacuation through a designated safe passageway," the White House said in a statement. The chief of staff of Russian forces, Valery Gerasimov, said on the Defence Ministry's Telegram channel that Russian troops would halt fire from 4 a.m. local time (0100 GMT) on October 27 to allow for the humanitarian operation to start. Ukraine's human rights ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets also [USN:S8N4390AW TEXT:"said"] the ceasefire would go into effect on October 27 and told Reuters the operation would involve demining roads to the town, deliveries of food and evacuations of civilians. MELANIA TRUMP'S DIPLOMATIC EFFORTS Both sides said Melania Trump played an important role in coordinating the agreement. The first lady has been active in trying to get Ukrainian children seized by Russia during the war returned to their families. "Oleshky is a front-line war city on the brink of disaster," she said in a statement. "Oleshky's remaining population is comprised primarily of elderly residents who urgently need medical attention, medicine, food and clean water." Pope Leo had spoken in the past week both to Zelenskiy and to Russian President Vladimir Putin about the situation in the town. The White House said Oleshky, located across the Dnipro River from the Ukrainian-held city of Kherson, had 1,700 to 2,000 residents remaining, down from 24,000 before the war. US ENVOYS Zelenskiy's comments on resuming peace talks followed a meeting with US presidential envoy Steve Witkoff in Norway early this week and a subsequent meeting between Witkoff and Putin in St Petersburg. Zelenskiy said he spoke on Friday with Witkoff and US envoy Jared Kushner. He said any peace agreement would need strong security guarantees for Ukraine and funding for 10 years to maintain the Ukrainian army. "The plan is to meet in the first half of November, and as early as possible, of course," Zelenskiy told the Hudson Institute think tank via a video link. He said much would depend on Russia, noting that a similar meeting expected this month had not materialised. Zelenskiy stressed the importance of continued diplomatic efforts to reach a ceasefire and end the war, now in its fifth year, adding that Europe should also be involved in the talks. Ukrainian officials said on Friday that speed restrictions on Starlink systems in Ukraine remained in place, despite Trump's previous statement that the services had been fully restored. Trump told reporters at the White House on Friday that he had not spoken to Musk about the restrictions but would do so if required. "If there is a problem, I'll get it straightened out," he said. The caps have been in place since October 13. Ukraine and Russia on Friday also swapped 270 servicemen each in a prisoner exchange, the Russian Defence Ministry said. Zelenskiy described the swap, the first since August, as a "very important result." Ukraine's acting prosecutor Anton Kovalskyi, writing on Telegram, said more than 19,000 [USN:S8N44Z032 TEXT:"Ukrainian civilians"], including 762 children, had been killed since Russia launched its full-scale war more than four years ago. In 2026 alone, Ukrainian prosecutors confirmed the deaths of 2,960 civilians, including 668 children, Kovalskyi said.

item.title: BOURSE Wall Street finit dans le rouge une semaine mouvementée autour de l'IA
item.description: La Bourse de New York a fini en baisse vendredi, au terme d'une semaine mouvementée pour le secteur de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) alors que les investisseurs ont désormais les yeux rivés sur de nouveaux résultats d'entreprises et la décision prochaine de politique monétaire de la Réserve fédérale américaine (Fed).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Bourse de New York a fini en baisse vendredi, au terme d'une semaine mouvementée pour le secteur de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) alors que les investisseurs ont désormais les yeux rivés sur de nouveaux résultats d'entreprises et la décision prochaine de politique monétaire de la Réserve fédérale américaine (Fed). L'indice Dow Jones (.DJI) a cédé 652,82 points, soit 1,23%, à 52.215,16. Le S&P-500 (.SPX) , plus large, a perdu 39,75 points, soit 0,51%, à 7.623,68. Le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) , riche en valeurs technologiques, a reculé de 53,51 points, soit 0,20%, à 25.955,34, affichant ainsi une certaine stabilité au lendemain de sa plus forte baisse quotidienne enregistrée depuis juin. Le Nasdaq a pâti cette semaine des inquiétudes concernant les coûts de financement nécessaires pour soutenir les dépenses d'investissement massives dans l'IA. La plupart des secteurs du S&P 500 ont terminé la séance dans le rouge, les biens de consommation courante et les groupes financiers accusant les plus fortes baisses. A contrario, l'indice Philadelphia Semiconductor (.SOX) a rebondi de 0,44%, au lendemain d'un important repli. Le secteur technologique sur le S&P 500 (.SPLRCT) a, lui, progressé de 0,35%. Sur l'ensemble de la semaine, le S&P 500 et le Nasdaq ont reflué respectivement de 0,47% et 0,71%, tandis que l'indice Dow Jones a grappillé 0,41%, soutenu notamment par les valeurs défensives. La semaine prochaine, environ un tiers des entreprises du S&P 500 publieront leurs résultats trimestriels, notamment Alphabet (GOOGL.O) (-1,23%), Microsoft (MSFT.O) (+0,65%) et Amazon (AMZN.O) (-0,95%), trois géants de l'IA dont les prévisions de dépenses d'investissement seront suivies de près à Wall Street. "Les remous liés aux interrogations sur le secteur de l'IA se font encore sentir", a souligné Kristina Hooper, cheffe stratège marchés chez Man Group. "Il est tout à fait possible que les investissements dans la construction de centres de données dédiés à l'IA soient l'année prochaine inférieurs aux prévisions. Je pense donc que cela donne matière à réflexion", a-t-elle dit. LE SECTEUR TÉLÉCOMS BOUSCULÉ PAR SPACEX Aux valeurs, les groupes télécoms ont reculé après une information selon laquelle SpaceX (SPCX.O) est à la recherche de milliers de sites de téléphonie mobile. AT&T (T.N) , Verizon (VZ.N) et T-Mobile (TMUS.O) ont cédé respectivement 7,95%, 1,26% et 7,71%, tandis que SpaceX a progressé de 1,89%. Les opérateurs de gestion des infrastructures mobiles comme Crown Castle (CCI.N) et American Tower (AMT.N) ont bondi respectivement de 9,13% et 4,07%. Le secteur de l'énergie (.SPNY) a pris 2,51%, touchant en séance un niveau record à 1.071,51 points alors que le baril de pétrole Brent a grimpé dans les échanges à un sommet depuis fin avril, à 117,45 dollars, à la suite des attaques des Houthis en Arabie saoudite. Cela a ravivé les craintes d'une nouvelle perturbation des approvisionnements énergétiques en provenance du Moyen-Orient. Sur le marché obligataire, le rendement deq bons du Trésor à dix ans a pris 4,7 points de base, à 5,00%, au lendemain de sa plus forte baisse quotidienne depuis près de quatre ans, en lien avec les inquiétudes concernant le caractère durable du redressement des actions liées à l'IA. Aux changes, le dollar (.DXY) affiche une hausse de 0,19% face à un panier de devises de référence alors que les investisseurs sont à l'affût d'indices quant à l'orientation future de la politique monétaire de la Fed. Les contrats à terme sur les fonds fédéraux montrent que les opérateurs ont réduit leurs paris sur une hausse des taux directeurs en décembre après la chute jeudi des marchés boursiers, mais ils évaluent toujours à 81% la probabilité d'une telle mesure, selon les données de LSEG.

item.title: Dale Brown dies at 90; coach turned LSU into national power
item.description: Dale Brown, who guided LSU men's basketball to two Final Fours in the 1980s and transformed the program into a national power during his 25-year coaching tenure in Baton Rouge, died Friday, the university announced. He was 90.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Dale Brown, who guided LSU men's basketball to two Final Fours in the 1980s and transformed the program into a national power during his 25-year coaching tenure in Baton Rouge, died Friday, the university announced. He was 90. Brown guided the Tigers to the national semifinals in 1981 and 1986. They lost to the eventual national champion both times: to Indiana in ‘81 and Louisville in ‘86. The Tigers made 13 NCAA Tournaments in all during Brown's time in charge. LSU's most famous alums under Brown are Shaquille O'Neal and Mahmoud Abdul-Rauf (formerly Chris Jackson), who added their names to program lore alongside Pete Maravich. But the program's greatest team successes, the Final Fours, came with future NBA players such as Rudy Macklin, Howard Carter, John "Hot Plate" Williams and Nikita Wilson leading the way. Brown came to Baton Rouge from Washington State in 1972. It was his first and, as it turned out, only head coaching job in the North Dakota native's career. He compiled a 448-301 record (.598 winning percentage) overall, and his teams went 238-200 in Southeastern Conference play. The Tigers won four SEC regular-season championships (1979, 1981, 1985, 1991) and one SEC Tournament title (1980) under Brown. Brown's coaching ability, gift of gab and charisma made him a national figure, but the latter two also made him an enemy of the NCAA in the 1980s and ‘90s. Brown spoke out strongly against the association, branding its officials as hypocrites and, famously, the Gestapo, for its heavy-handedness regarding benefits to players. The NCAA took away two scholarships from the program in 1986 after it found LSU guilty of 16 violations. Brown met his coaching end a decade later after another run-in with the NCAA. At the time, the association was investigating the program over a $5,000 payment made by an LSU booster to former player Lester Earl. The NCAA found no evidence that Brown was directly involved in the payment, but the program was placed on probation in 1998 nonetheless. Brown retired in 1997. Those incidents did not tarnish Brown's legacy entirely. He was inducted into the Louisiana Sports Hall of Fame in 1999, the LSU Athletics Hall of Fame in 2013 and the National Collegiate Basketball Hall of Fame in 2014. This week, he was announced as the 2027 recipient of the John R. Wooden Legends of Coach Award. --Field Level Media

item.title: Soja sobe em Chicago com vendas para exportação dos EUA e alta do petróleo
item.description: Os contratos futuros de soja negociados na bolsa de Chicago subiram nesta sexta-feira, à medida que as vendas para exportação dos EUA compensaram o impacto da pressão da colheita, e o setor de energia também contribuiu para a alta.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros de soja negociados na bolsa de Chicago subiram nesta sexta-feira, à medida que as vendas para exportação dos EUA compensaram o impacto da pressão da colheita, e o setor de energia também contribuiu para a alta. O Departamento de Agricultura dos Estados Unidos (USDA) informou que as vendas líquidas de soja dos EUA na semana encerrada em 15 de outubro totalizaram 2.841.200 toneladas métricas, um aumento significativo em relação à média das quatro semanas anteriores, mas em linha com as expectativas do mercado, que variavam entre 1,8 milhão e 3 milhões de toneladas. O USDA informou na quinta-feira que os exportadores venderam 202.000 toneladas métricas de soja para a China com entrega prevista para a safra 2026/2027. Os preços do petróleo subiram nesta sexta-feira, com o petróleo Brent atingindo seu maior nível desde o início de maio, depois que ataques dos houthis na Arábia Saudita alimentaram preocupações com novas interrupções no abastecimento do Oriente Médio, onde as autoridades dos Emirados Árabes Unidos também relataram um vazamento de petróleo. Alguns agricultores dos EUA estavam concluindo a colheita de soja após um período de clima favorável no Meio-Oeste e passavam a colher milho, segundo analistas. O contrato de soja novembro fechou com alta de 3,50 centavos, a US$12,565 por bushel. Já o milho fechou em baixa com o avanço da colheita. O contrato dezembro encerrou em queda de 4,50 centavos, a US$4,56 o bushel. O trigo terminou praticamente estável, a US$6,25 o bushel. (Por Renee Hickman)

item.title: La IndyCar vuelve a Europa tras 20 años de ausencia con una carrera en casa para Palou
item.description: La IndyCar volverá a competir en Europa por primera vez en 20 años con una prueba que se celebrará en julio de 2027 en el Circuito de Cataluña, en Barcelona, en el marco de un acuerdo plurianual anunciado el viernes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La IndyCar volverá a competir en Europa por primera vez en 20 años con una prueba que se celebrará en julio de 2027 en el Circuito de Cataluña, en Barcelona, en el marco de un acuerdo plurianual anunciado el viernes. La carrera supondrá el regreso a casa del español Alex Palou, cinco veces campeón de la IndyCar, que nació cerca de Barcelona. La última vez que la IndyCar compitió en Europa fue en el circuito de Assen, en Países Bajos, en 2007. El campeonato no ha disputado ninguna carrera fuera de Norteamérica desde 2013, cuando se celebró una prueba en Brasil. Palou, de 29 años, ha ganado los últimos cuatro títulos de IndyCar y también se alzó con la victoria en las 500 Millas de Indianápolis en 2025. El Circuito de Cataluña acogió este año una prueba de Fórmula 1, pero desaparece del calendario en 2027 y se alternará con Bélgica hasta 2032. "Llevamos años siendo testigos de su extraordinario talento (el de Palou) y sabemos que sus seguidores en España están deseando verle competir en directo", dijo Mark Miles, director general de Penske Entertainment Corp., propietaria de IndyCar. "Es una oportunidad increíble, y para mí significa mucho poder correr en casa, en Barcelona; es difícil expresarlo con palabras. Sé que a los aficionados les va a encantar, y creo que vamos a ofrecer un gran espectáculo", dijo Palou. La carrera de 2027 se celebrará del 16 al 18 de julio.

item.title: Colombiano Ecopetrol estima utilidad neta de 4 a 5 billones de pesos en el tercer trimestre
item.description: La utilidad neta del grupo energético colombiano Ecopetrol se habría situado en un rango de 4 a 5 billones de pesos (1.255 a 1.569 millones de dólares) en el tercer trimestre, según estimaciones del conglomerado divulgadas el viernes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La utilidad neta del grupo energético colombiano Ecopetrol se habría situado en un rango de 4 a 5 billones de pesos (1.255 a 1.569 millones de dólares) en el tercer trimestre, según estimaciones del conglomerado divulgadas el viernes. En el segundo trimestre, Ecopetrol registró una ganancia neta de 6,06 billones de pesos (1.902 millones de dólares). De acuerdo con la actualización operativa de la compañía publicada en su página de internet, los ingresos totales se habrían situado en un rango de 33 a 36 billones de pesos (10.361 a 11.302 millones de dólares) en el periodo de julio a septiembre. Ecopetrol no suministró ninguna variación porcentual de las proyecciones. Por su parte, la producción en el tercer trimestre habría alcanzado un rango de entre 740.000 y 750.000 barriles equivalentes de petróleo promedio día (bpd). Las proyecciones de Ecopetrol supondrían un incremento en la producción frente a los 705.800 bpd del segundo trimestre de 2026. Ecopetrol, controlada mayoritariamente por el Estado, es la empresa más grande de Colombia, produce la mayor parte del petróleo del país y posee las dos principales refinerías y gran parte de la red de oleoductos y poliductos. (1 dólar = 3.185,01 pesos colombianos).

item.title: Rusia dice que tres petroleros cargados con diésel se dirigen a Norteamérica
item.description: Tres petroleros que transportan diésel ruso se dirigen a Norteamérica, dijo el viernes el vice primer ministro ruso, Alexander Novak.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tres petroleros que transportan diésel ruso se dirigen a Norteamérica, dijo el viernes el vice primer ministro ruso, Alexander Novak. Novak, en unas declaraciones recogidas por las agencias de noticias rusas, señaló que los cargamentos formaban parte de un acuerdo para abastecer a los mercados estadounidense y mundial. "Los tres primeros buques cisterna ya se dirigen hacia la costa oriental del océano Atlántico, con un importante apoyo del RDIF (Fondo Ruso de Inversión Directa)", dijo Novak. Novak señaló que las empresas rusas podrían suministrar 500.000 toneladas métricas en octubre. En virtud de un acuerdo anunciado este mes por el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, Rusia accedió a suministrar diésel a los mercados globales, en un esfuerzo por reducir los precios del combustible. El Gobierno de Trump suspendió temporalmente las sanciones estadounidenses sobre el combustible ruso, que tenían por objeto privar a Moscú de ingresos para su guerra contra Ucrania. El acuerdo anunciado por Trump contemplaba 300.000 toneladas métricas en octubre y más posteriormente. Una noticia exclusiva de Reuters publicada el viernes, que citaba datos de seguimiento de buques, indicaba que el primer cargamento de diésel ruso se encontraba a bordo de un petrolero con destino a Nueva York.

item.title: Swiss drug developer Windward Bio files for US IPO
item.description: Windward Bio filed for a US initial public offering on Friday, becoming the latest drug developer seeking to capitalize on renewed investor interest in biotech listings.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Windward Bio filed for a US initial public offering on Friday, becoming the latest drug developer seeking to capitalize on renewed investor interest in biotech listings. Biotech has been one of the more active sectors in this year's fall IPO market, even as rising bond yields and concerns around the AI trade weigh on broader risk appetite. Here are more details: Basel, Switzerland-based Windward Bio is developing long-lasting antibody treatments for asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and inflammatory skin conditions, with the aim of reducing how frequently patients need injections WIN378, the company's lead drug candidate, is an antibody designed to block thymic stromal lymphopoietin, or TSLP, which is a protein that triggers several inflammatory pathways involved in asthma and other respiratory diseases Novo Holdings and funds managed by Blue Owl Capital have pre-IPO stakes of 14.5% and 5.9%, respectively, in the company Windward has secured up to $365 million from investors including OrbiMed, Novo Holdings, Omega Funds and Blue Owl Healthcare Opportunities The company plans to list its shares on Nasdaq under the symbol "WWB". Jefferies, TD Cowen, Piper Sandler and UBS Investment Bank are the underwriters for the offering

item.title: Colombia's Ecopetrol sees Q3 profit drop to up to $1.57 billion
item.description: Colombian state-run energy company Ecopetrol estimated its third-quarter net profit at 4 trillion to 5 trillion pesos ($1.26 billion to $1.57 billion), the company said on Friday, a decline from the 6.06 trillion pesos ($1.90 billion) it posted in the second quarter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Colombian state-run energy company Ecopetrol (ECOPETROL.CN) estimated its third-quarter net profit at 4 trillion to 5 trillion pesos ($1.26 billion to $1.57 billion), the company said on Friday, a decline from the 6.06 trillion pesos ($1.90 billion) it posted in the second quarter. Total revenue for July-September quarter was estimated at 33 trillion to 36 trillion pesos ($10.36 billion to $11.30 billion), Ecopetrol said. Third-quarter production is estimated to have reached between 740,000 to 750,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day (bpd), an increase from the 705,800 bpd the company reported in the second quarter. In September Ecopetrol [USN:L1N45G0ZI TEXT:"appointed businessman Joaquin Gutierrez"] as its chief executive, giving one of the country's most important corporate jobs to a close presidential ally with no known background in the energy sector. Colombia's right-wing President Abelardo De La Espriella, who took office in August, has promised to strengthen Ecopetrol, boost reserves and secure domestic oil and gas supply, including through fracking. Ecopetrol is majority state-controlled and Colombia's largest company, generating most of the South American country's oil production. The company owns the two main refineries and most of the country's oil and product pipeline network. ($1 = 3.185,01 pesos)

item.title: Costa Rica AG says new joint DEA ops will target politicians, businessmen
item.description: Costa Rica will deepen cooperation with the US Drug Enforcement Administration to target what the nation's newly re-elected attorney general calls "invisible drug traffickers," including business executives and politicians hiding alleged links to the drug trade behind respectable public profiles.
item.dc:creator: Alvaro Murillo
item.content:encoded: Costa Rica will deepen cooperation with the US Drug Enforcement Administration to target what the nation's newly re-elected attorney general calls "invisible drug traffickers," including business executives and politicians hiding alleged links to the drug trade behind respectable public profiles. Attorney General Carlo Diaz, who has repeatedly clashed with the government of President Laura Fernandez, was re-elected by the judiciary on Monday to another four-year term. In an interview with Reuters on Thursday, he said investigators would show no leniency if those implicated held senior positions. "This second phase (of DEA cooperation) focuses on people we have termed 'invisible drug traffickers,'" Diaz said, after an initial phase of joint missions targeted members of criminal organizations. "These are business people, sometimes professionals or politicians, who are successful or highly visible. But behind that facade lies a direct link with these kinds of activities." Diaz also hailed Costa Rica's ability to extradite its own nationals to the US as a watershed in the fight against transnational crime, saying 6 people had been sent and another 25 extradition proceedings were underway. The DEA's office did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Costa Rica's government has previously collaborated with the DEA to arrest dozens of [USN:L6N44A17E TEXT:"drug traffickers"], who Costa Rican authorities deem responsible for a surge in homicide rates over recent years in the long-peaceful Central American nation. Officials have said the region serves as a key corridor shifting narcotics from South America to the US. Fernandez, a conservative ally of President Donald Trump, has aligned Costa Rica closely with Washington on security, joining the US president’s [USN:L6N45E0S9 TEXT:"Shield of the Americas"] initiative against drug trafficking and organized crime. POLITICAL DIVISIONS Diaz said DEA officials had directly expressed concern to him about political and institutional divisions in Costa Rica, which he said were hampering the fight against organized crime. He has repeatedly clashed with Fernandez and her predecessor Rodrigo Chaves, accusing the government of seeking to weaken the judiciary. Despite backing deeper cooperation with the DEA, Diaz rejected Fernandez's suggestion last month that Costa Rica could benefit from [USN:S0N3ST094 TEXT:"US forces operating on its territory"]. "If we focus on providing the resources the security forces need, they could take control of the territory without needing to bring in armed forces from other countries," he said. Fernandez’s government has built a 5,100-capacity prison modeled on El Salvador’s security crackdown, an approach Diaz has questioned amid his broader clashes with the government. He said the prison could ease overcrowding but would not itself curb organized crime, stressing that Costa Rica’s criminal landscape differs sharply from El Salvador’s. The homicide rate in Costa Rica, long considered one of the region's safest countries, peaked at 17.2 per 100,000 people in 2023, or 906 killings. "This is one of the most complex moments in our history," Diaz said. "(The DEA) is well aware of the situation."

item.title: USDA corrige dados de setembro do milho dos EUA devido a "erro de processamento"
item.description: O Departamento de Agricultura dos Estados Unidos (USDA) corrigiu os dados sobre o milho divulgados em setembro, após um "erro de processamento" afetar as previsões de rendimento e produção do país, informou a agência nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Departamento de Agricultura dos Estados Unidos (USDA) corrigiu os dados sobre o milho divulgados em setembro, após um "erro de processamento" afetar as previsões de rendimento e produção do país, informou a agência nesta sexta-feira. O USDA tem enfrentado críticas de comerciantes de grãos, analistas e economistas quanto à confiabilidade de suas estimativas de safra devido a uma série de erros nos dados. A agência, há muito considerada o padrão ouro em informações sobre o mercado agrícola global, havia afirmado anteriormente que buscava aprimorar suas estimativas de safra. O Serviço Nacional de Estatísticas Agrícolas (NASS, na sigla em inglês) do USDA descobriu o erro após surgirem preocupações sobre um relatório de safra divulgado neste mês, que projetava que os agricultores dos EUA colheriam mais bushels de milho do que o esperado anteriormente, de acordo com o comunicado da agência. A previsão de safra acima do esperado causou uma queda nos futuros de milho dos EUA. "O NASS identificou um erro de processamento que afetou as populações de plantas de milho, a contagem de espigas, os rendimentos e a produção de setembro para o Kansas e o Nebraska", afirmou o comunicado. "O erro também afetou as médias de 10 Estados para setembro em relação às populações de plantas e contagem de espigas, além das previsões de rendimento e produção de milho nos EUA." Um relatório CORREÇÃO, publicado pelo USDA em seu site, apresentou um rendimento do milho em setembro de 178,8 bushels por acre. No mês passado, o USDA informou que sua estimativa de rendimento para setembro era de 178,5 bushels por acre. O USDA revisou sua estimativa de produção para setembro para 15,828 bilhões de bushels, ante a estimativa original de 15,800 bilhões. As previsões para a safra de outubro foram revisadas, validadas e não sofreram alterações, informou o USDA. (Reportagem de Tom Polansek)

item.title: SoftBank-backed OPay eyes up to $4.4 billion US IPO valuation
item.description: OPay is targeting a valuation of up to $4.42 billion in its US initial public offering, the digital payments company said on Friday, seeking to capitalize on growing demand for digital financial services in emerging markets.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: OPay is targeting a valuation of up to $4.42 billion in its US initial public offering, the digital payments company said on Friday, seeking to capitalize on growing demand for digital financial services in emerging markets. The Nigeria-focused firm is seeking up to $366 million by offering roughly 16 million American Depositary Shares between $19 and $21 apiece. The offering comes as the United States IPO market faces renewed pressure from higher inflation and a selloff in AI-related stocks, weighing on investor appetite for new listings and prompting several companies to delay their listing plans. Founded in 2018, OPay provides digital financial services, including payments, money transfers, savings and loans, and also operates in Indonesia, Egypt and Pakistan. Nigeria, the world's sixth-most-populous country, has emerged as one of Africa's leading fintech markets, producing several fintech companies including Moniepoint, Flutterwave and Interswitch, according to Tracxn. OPay was founded by Chinese billionaire Yahui Zhou, who also founded Beijing Kunlun Tech, a Chinese gaming company that previously owned dating app Grindr. The company raised $400 million in 2021 at a valuation of $2 billion. It had about 50 million monthly active users as of July 31, according to its IPO prospectus. SoftBank entities own a 6.6% stake in OPay before the offering, according to the filing. Investors including Redwheel Group, Coronation Africa Frontiers Fund and other existing backers have indicated non-binding interest in buying up to $270 million worth of ADS. Stanbic Africa Holdings has separately agreed to invest as much as $200 million through a concurrent private placement. OPay plans to use the proceeds from its IPO and concurrent private placement to invest in technology, expand its distribution network and markets, develop new products and pursue potential acquisitions and strategic investments. Citigroup, Deutsche Bank, Standard Bank and CICC are among the offering's underwriters. OPay will list on the NYSE under the "OPAY" symbol.

item.title: Trump diz que EUA vão “cuidar de Cuba” depois de lidarem com Irã
item.description: O presidente Donald Trump afirmou nesta sexta-feira que os Estados Unidos cuidariam de Cuba depois de lidarem com o Irã e que enviariam o secretário de Estado Marco Rubio para finalizar o acordo.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: O presidente Donald Trump afirmou nesta sexta-feira que os Estados Unidos cuidariam de Cuba depois de lidarem com o Irã e que enviariam o secretário de Estado Marco Rubio para finalizar o acordo. “Vamos cuidar de Cuba após o Irã... depois, vamos enviar Marco Rubio para finalizar o acordo”, disse Trump em um comício na Flórida. Trump previu no mês passado que os EUA e Cuba chegariam a um acordo e que não acreditava que uma ação militar fosse necessária. O governo Trump já havia declarado anteriormente que seu objetivo é mudar o governo comunista de Cuba. Um bloqueio petrolífero imposto pelos EUA no início deste ano colocou Cuba sob forte pressão, já que o país enfrenta escassez de combustível e apagões agravados pela infraestrutura precária. Washington mantém um embargo contra Cuba há mais de 60 anos, e o governo Trump vem intensificando a pressão sobre Havana depois que as Forças Armadas dos EUA capturaram, em janeiro, o então presidente venezuelano, Nicolás Maduro. O ministro das Relações Exteriores de Cuba afirmou na Assembleia Geral da ONU, no mês passado, que Cuba estaria sempre aberta ao diálogo com Washington.

item.title: Trump afirma que EEUU "se ocupará de Cuba" después de Irán
item.description: El presidente Donald Trump dijo el viernes que Estados Unidos se ocuparía de Cuba una vez resuelto el asunto de Irán y que enviaría al secretario de Estado, Marco Rubio, para cerrar el acuerdo.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: El presidente Donald Trump dijo el viernes que Estados Unidos se ocuparía de Cuba una vez resuelto el asunto de Irán y que enviaría al secretario de Estado, Marco Rubio, para cerrar el acuerdo. "Nos ocuparemos de Cuba a la vuelta de Irán... y luego enviaremos a Marco Rubio para que cierre el acuerdo", dijo Trump en un mitin celebrado en Florida. Trump predijo el mes pasado que Estados Unidos y Cuba llegarían a un acuerdo y que no creía que fuese necesaria una acción militar. La administración de Trump ha declarado anteriormente que su objetivo es cambiar el Gobierno comunista de Cuba. El confinamiento petrolero impuesto por Estados Unidos a principios de este año ha sometido a Cuba a una grave crisis, ya que el país se enfrenta a la escasez de combustible y a cortes de electricidad, agravados por una infraestructura deficiente. Washington lleva más de 60 años manteniendo un embargo contra Cuba y el Gobierno de Trump ha intensificado la presión sobre La Habana después de que, en enero, el ejército estadounidense capturara al entonces presidente venezolano Nicolás Maduro en una incursión mortal. El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores de Cuba dijo el mes pasado ante la Asamblea General de la ONU que Cuba siempre estaría abierta al diálogo con Washington.

item.title: Açúcar bruto registra primeira alta na bolsa ICE em 6 pregões com força do petróleo
item.description: Os contratos futuros de açúcar bruto na bolsa ICE subiram pela primeira vez em seis sessões, à medida que os preços do petróleo se recuperaram e as preocupações climáticas relacionadas ao El Niño persistiram, enquanto o café registrou queda.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros de açúcar bruto na bolsa ICE subiram pela primeira vez em seis sessões, à medida que os preços do petróleo se recuperaram e as preocupações climáticas relacionadas ao El Niño persistiram, enquanto o café registrou queda. AÇÚCAR * O contrato de açúcar bruto fechou com alta de 0,11 centavo, ou 0,5%, a 20,24 centavos por libra-peso, após cair pela quinta sessão consecutiva na quinta-feira e fechar em queda de 1,6%. O mercado registrou perda de 3% na semana. * Consumidores e operadores provavelmente entraram no mercado como compradores, vendo uma boa oportunidade após as recentes quedas, já que não faltam fatores de alta no mercado, disse o consultor Michael McDougall. * Entre esses fatores estão o excesso de chuvas associadas ao El Niño no Brasil, principal produtor, e novos aumentos nos preços do petróleo , o que pode levar as usinas de cana a reduzir a produção de açúcar e intensificar a produção de etanol como combustível. * Além disso, a Índia prorrogou o prazo para permitir a importação isenta de impostos de 1 milhão de toneladas métricas de açúcar bruto de 31 de outubro para 31 de dezembro, dando aos importadores mais tempo para trazer a commodity para o maior país consumidor de açúcar do mundo. * Os preços do açúcar na Índia, que também é o segundo maior produtor mundial de açúcar, estão disparando, já que o país enfrenta chuvas de monção abaixo do normal devido ao fenômeno climático El Niño. * O açúcar branco subiu 0,2%, para US$534,80 por tonelada métrica, embora tenha registrado uma perda semanal de 3,6%. CAFÉ * O café arábica fechou em queda de 5 centavos, ou 1,6%, a US$3,0745 por libra-peso, após ter atingido na quarta-feira uma máxima de seis semanas de US$3,1820. Ele registrou alta de 0,6% na semana. * O café está sendo impulsionado por estoques da bolsa extremamente baixos e por um real forte , o que desestimula os exportadores do Brasil, principal produtor, a vender café cotado em dólares, uma vez que isso reduz os retornos em moeda local. * Os estoques de arábica na ICE caíram novamente na sexta-feira para 227.978 sacas, perto do nível mais baixo em 27 anos. * Os operadores estão acompanhando a eleição presidencial deste domingo no Brasil, que poderia consolidar novos ganhos para o real caso o candidato da oposição, Flávio Bolsonaro, vença, conforme indicam as pesquisas. * O preço do café robusta caiu 1,8%, para US$3.242 a tonelada. O mercado de robusta registrou queda de 5% na semana. CACAU * O cacau de Londres fechou com alta de 15 libras, ou 0,3%, a 4.311 libras por tonelada, após ter fechado com queda de 3,9% na quinta-feira. * O cacau de Nova York ficou praticamente inalterado, a US$5.592 por tonelada. * Ambos os mercados registraram uma queda semanal de 1%. (Reportagem de May Angel e Marcelo Teixeira)

item.title: African Champions League holders knocked out in second round
item.description: Holders Mamelodi Sundowns of South Africa were bundled out of the African Champions League in the second preliminary round on Friday, beaten on the away goals rule by Wiliete from Angola.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Holders Mamelodi Sundowns of South Africa were bundled out of the African Champions League in the second preliminary round on Friday, beaten on the away goals rule by Wiliete from Angola. The second leg at Loftus Versfeld in Pretoria finished 1-1 five days after the two sides had played out a goalless draw in Lubango in the first leg last Sunday. Sundowns went ahead after 11 minutes through Tashreeq Matthews but Angola international Mabululu equalised four minutes into the second half. Wiliete then produced a stout rearguard action to reach the group phase for the first time. The lineup for the next round, where 16 teams will be divided into four groups, will be decided on Sunday when the last of the preliminary round matches are played. Sundowns qualified for the group phase in the previous 11 editions of the Champions League and their defeat ranks among the competition's biggest shocks.

item.title: Justicia argentina archiva investigación contra presidente Milei en escándalo de criptomoneda
item.description: La investigación penal sobre el papel del presidente argentino Javier Milei y su hermana Karina en un escándalo relacionado con una criptomoneda viral fue archivada el viernes, según consta en registros judiciales.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La investigación penal sobre el papel del presidente argentino Javier Milei y su hermana Karina en un escándalo relacionado con una criptomoneda viral fue archivada el viernes, según consta en registros judiciales. Según el periódico local La Nación, el juez federal Marcelo Martínez de Giorgi dictó la orden luego de que el fiscal Eduardo Taiano solicitara el sobreseimiento. En febrero de 2025 se designó a un juez para investigar el papel de Milei en la promoción de una criptomoneda que se desplomó. Milei había recomendado la poco conocida criptomoneda $LIBRA en una publicación en su cuenta de X, lo que provocó un breve repunte. Posteriormente, eliminó la publicación y negó cualquier vínculo con la criptomoneda, cuyo precio pronto se desplomó. La investigación había analizado un posible fraude relacionado con el lanzamiento de la criptomoneda. En el momento del desplome de la moneda, Milei afirmó haber actuado "de buena fe" y acusó a sus rivales políticos de intentar aprovecharse de la situación.

item.content:encoded: La petrolera North America Blue Energy Partners (NABEP) ha incrementado la extracción de crudo en su mayor proyecto activo, Petrozamora, hasta alcanzar los 115.000 barriles diarios (bpd), dijo el viernes su director ejecutivo, Alejandro Betancourt. item.title: Trump says US will 'take care of Cuba' on its way back from Iran
item.description: President Donald Trump said on Friday the United States would take care of Cuba after dealing with Iran and would send Secretary of State Marco Rubio to finish the deal.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump said on Friday the United States would take care of Cuba after dealing with Iran and would send Secretary of State Marco Rubio to finish the deal. "We'll take care of Cuba on our way back from Iran ... then we're going to send Marco Rubio in to finish up the deal," Trump told a rally in Florida. Trump [USN:L1N45I044 TEXT:"predicted last month"] the US and Cuba would reach an agreement and that he did not think military action would be necessary. The Trump administration [USN:L1N45L02I TEXT:"has previously stated"] its goal is to change Cuba's communist government. A US-imposed oil blockade implemented earlier this year has put Cuba under severe strain as it contends with fuel shortages and [USN:L1N44002K TEXT:"blackouts"] exacerbated by failing infrastructure. Washington has maintained an embargo on Cuba for more than 60 years and the Trump administration has been [USN:L1N4590T5 TEXT:"stepping up pressure"] on Havana after the US military in January seized then-Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro in a deadly raid. Cuba's foreign minister told the UN General Assembly last month Cuba would always be open for dialogue with Washington.

item.title: Ravens list QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) as questionable vs. Bengals
item.description: Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson was listed as questionable for his team's home game Sunday against the Cincinnati Bengals because of a left ankle injury.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson was listed as questionable for his team's home game Sunday against the Cincinnati Bengals because of a left ankle injury. Jackson was limited at practice for a third consecutive day on Friday because of an injury he picked up against the Tennessee Titans back on Oct. 4. The two-time MVP quarterback missed the second half of the Titans game and the following two games -- a Baltimore win at Atlanta and last week's loss in Cleveland -- while recovering from the injury. "He's still got a lot of work to do in order to be able to play on Sunday, but he's really working at it behind the scenes," Ravens offensive coordinator Declan Doyle said Thursday. "It's great having him in the meeting room. And it's another thing to be able to have him out there on the field with us and continuing to push and his teammates seeing him push and all that stuff." Jackson has six TD passes and one interception plus a rushing touchdown in 14 total quarters played in 2026. In his stead, Baltimore turned to Tyler Huntley at quarterback the past two weeks. Jackson is 11-2 as a starter against Cincinnati in his career with 3,699 total yards (2,868 passing) and 26 TDs (two rushing TDs). The Ravens are one of three 4-2 teams in the AFC North and lead the division in points (156) while ranking last in points allowed (132). Baltimore has 116 points and 14 touchdowns with Jackson at quarterback this season, compared to 40 points and four touchdowns without him. --Field Level Media

item.title: Detained migrants have no constitutional right to bond hearings, US court rules
item.description: A US appeals court ruled on Friday that President Donald Trump's administration is not required under the US Constitution to give detained immigrants a chance to seek release on bond.
item.dc:creator: Nate Raymond
item.content:encoded: A US appeals court ruled on Friday that President Donald Trump 's administration is not required under the US Constitution to give detained immigrants a chance to seek release on bond. In a 10-7 ruling powered by its conservative majority, the New Orleans-based 5th US Circuit Court of Appeals decided that the Constitution's Fifth Amendment due process protections do not require that immigration detainees receive bond hearings. "To the extent petitioners seek to vindicate a liberty interest to be free from physical restraint in the most abstract sense, they can do so at any moment by agreeing to leave the country," US Circuit Judge Cory Wilson, a Trump appointee, wrote in the decision. The ruling, if left to stand, would eliminate a key avenue for detained migrants in the three states under the 5th Circuit's jurisdiction — Texas, Louisiana and Mississippi — to argue for release, especially if the US Supreme Court decides the administration's detention practice complies with immigration law. The Supreme Court this month [USN:L1N45N0KS TEXT:"agreed to consider"] the issue, which has divided lower courts. Numerous lawsuits by migrants arguing they were being unlawfully detained have flooded the courts as US Immigration and Customs Enforcement, or ICE, implemented Trump's mass deportation agenda. The Supreme Court is considering only whether such hearings are required by statute, not by the Constitution, the issue the 5th Circuit addressed with Friday's decision. While the 5th Circuit in February had adopted the administration's reading of immigration law as requiring mandatory detention, a 2-1 panel of the court in July held that ICE could not constitutionally detain people for more than 90 days without providing hearings to argue for release on bond. The decision, which came in lawsuits by two Mexican citizens and one Honduran, carried particular importance because Texas and Louisiana, within the 5th Circuit's jurisdiction, house the nation's largest numbers of immigration detainees. But the full 5th Circuit agreed to rehear the case, and on Friday reversed course, concluding that detained immigrants are not constitutionally entitled to proceedings in immigration court beyond what Congress provided by statute. "This ruling opens the door to more people being locked up for no reason, with devastating consequences for them, their loved ones and their community," Ellie Norton, a lawyer for the non-US citizens in the case at the National Immigration Project, said in a statement. James Percival, the general counsel for the US Department of Homeland Security, in a social media post hailed what he called a "big win in the 5th Circuit on mandatory detention for illegal aliens." Among the dissenting judges was US Circuit Judge Dana Douglas, an appointee of Democratic President Joe Biden, who wrote that "unchecked, executive authority to arrest and detain, indefinitely, echoes fearfully from history."

item.title: Wall Street fecha em baixa, encerrando semana volátil
item.description: Os principais índices de Wall Street fecharam em baixa nesta sexta-feira, mesmo com as ações do setor de tecnologia se estabilizando um pouco, encerrando uma semana turbulenta para o setor de IA que impulsiona o mercado, com os investidores aguardando uma agenda repleta de divulgações de resultados corporativos e uma reunião do Federal Reserve sobre a política de taxas de juros.
item.dc:creator: Lewis Krauskopf, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Ragini Mathur
item.content:encoded: Os principais índices de Wall Street fecharam em baixa nesta sexta-feira, mesmo com as ações do setor de tecnologia se estabilizando um pouco, encerrando uma semana turbulenta para o setor de IA que impulsiona o mercado, com os investidores aguardando uma agenda repleta de divulgações de resultados corporativos e uma reunião do Federal Reserve sobre a política de taxas de juros. O Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) registrou uma leve baixa um dia depois que o índice predominantemente tecnológico sofreu sua maior queda em um único dia desde junho, à medida que aumentavam as preocupações com os custos de financiamento para sustentar os pesados gastos com investimentos em IA. O setor de tecnologia do S&P 500 registrou um ganho de 0,35% nesta sexta-feira. A maioria dos setores do S&P 500, no entanto, registrou quedas, incluindo recuos bem acima de 1% nos setores de bens de consumo básico e bens de consumo discricionário, bem como no setor financeiro. Na próxima semana, cerca de um terço das empresas do S&P 500 divulgará seus resultados trimestrais, incluindo a Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , a Microsoft (MSFT.O) e a Amazon (AMZN.O) — três gigantes da IA cujas previsões de gastos de capital serão acompanhadas de perto em Wall Street. “Ainda há repercussões do questionamento em torno do setor de IA”, disse Kristina Hooper, estrategista-chefe de mercado da Man Group. “Certamente existe a possibilidade de vermos menos investimentos na expansão de data centers de IA no próximo ano do que o projetado. Portanto, acredito que isso esteja causando uma pausa.” O Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) caiu 1,23%, para 52.215,16 pontos; o S&P 500 (.SPX) perdeu 0,52%, para 7.623,68 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) recuou 0,21%, para 25.955,34 pontos. Na semana, o S&P 500 recuou 0,5% e o Nasdaq caiu 0,7%. O Dow Jones, índice de blue chips, subiu 0,4%, registrando seu terceiro ganho semanal consecutivo. As ações de telecomunicações caíram e pesaram sobre o setor de serviços de comunicação, após uma reportagem afirmar que a SpaceX buscava milhares de locais para antenas de telefonia celular para uma quarta operadora móvel. As ações da AT&T (T.N) e da T-Mobile (TMUS.O) afundaram quase 8%, enquanto a Verizon (VZ.N) recuou 1,2%. As ações da SpaceX subiram 1,9%. As operadoras de torres de telefonia celular dos EUA registraram ganhos, com a Crown Castle (CCI.N) saltando 9% e a American Tower (AMT.N) subindo 4%. O setor de energia (.SPNY) subiu 2,5%, atingindo uma máxima recorde. O petróleo Brent atingiu seu nível mais alto desde o final de abril, depois que ataques dos houthis na Arábia Saudita alimentaram preocupações com novas interrupções no fornecimento de energia do Oriente Médio. As ações da American Express (AXP.N) caíram 3,7%, pesando sobre o Dow. A empresa elevou sua previsão de lucro ao mesmo tempo em que anunciou planos para eliminar 5% de sua força de trabalho. As ações da SLB (SLB.N) saltaram 7% depois que a prestadora de serviços para campos petrolíferos superou as estimativas de Wall Street para o lucro do terceiro trimestre. Dados da Universidade de Michigan mostraram que a confiança do consumidor nos EUA recuou ligeiramente em outubro, aproximando-se de uma mínima histórica, à medida que o aumento dos preços devido ao conflito no Oriente Médio prejudicou a percepção das famílias sobre a economia. O foco do mercado continua voltado para a temporada de resultados, com o robusto crescimento dos lucros corporativos sustentando as altas dos principais índices de ações neste ano. As empresas do S&P 500 devem registrar um aumento nos lucros de mais de 32% no terceiro trimestre, de acordo com dados da LSEG IBES. Espera-se que o Fed mantenha as taxas de juros inalteradas quando divulgar sua declaração de política monetária na quarta-feira, mas os investidores estarão ansiosos por indícios sobre se o banco central dos EUA aumentará as taxas em sua reunião de dezembro. Wall Street também está cada vez mais focada nas eleições de meio de mandato de 3 de novembro, que decidirão o controle do Congresso dos EUA.

item.title: Instacart in talks with DoorDash and Uber for sale, The Information reports
item.description: Instacart is exploring a possible sale and has held preliminary discussions with potential buyers including Uber and DoorDash, The Information reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Instacart (CART.O) is exploring a possible sale and has held preliminary discussions with potential buyers including Uber and DoorDash, The Information reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter. Shares of Instacart closed about 9% higher on Friday. The company had a market value of about $12 billion as of Thursday's close. A potential takeover by Uber or DoorDash could bolster the buyer's online grocery delivery ambitions by combining Instacart's established marketplace and retailer ties with its own vast delivery network and customer base. But either deal could draw antitrust scrutiny, as it would bulk up two of the biggest food-delivery platforms in the US and add to a wave of consolidation. In July, Uber struck a nearly $15 billion deal to buy Germany's Delivery Hero. Shares of Uber (UBER.N) closed down around 3% while DoorDash (DASH.O) were 4% lower. Instacart declined to comment when contacted by Reuters, while Uber and DoorDash did not immediately respond. Discussions are ongoing with no guarantee of a deal, the report said, adding that a typical takeover premium of 30% to 40% would value Instacart at roughly $16 billion to $17 billion, based on recent public technology deals. Last year, Instacart lowered its minimum order for free delivery for Instacart+ members to $10, as rivals DoorDash and Uber Eats expand grocery and convenience delivery. Amazon (AMZN.O) is also expanding its quick delivery service, Amazon Now, which delivers groceries and essentials in 30 minutes or less. "Instacart risks getting squeezed between retailers building their own digital channels and larger platforms that can bundle grocery with other services, giving consumers more reasons to keep coming back," Emarketer analyst Zak Stambor said. "For Instacart, a deal could provide the resources and reach to compete more effectively than it could on its own," he said. In 2021, DoorDash had held talks to acquire Instacart, legally known as Maplebear, in a potential deal that would have valued it between $40 billion and $50 billion, [USN:L4N2PI4JF TEXT:"The Information"] had reported. The concerns about Biden administration's antitrust approval derailed the talks. Stambor said the latest deal is plausible as the Trump administration has shown "greater willingness" to approve deals even as "it could come at the cost of selling off parts of the business."

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Sam Altman-led OpenAI said on Friday it had resumed reinforcement learning training and internal use of its most advanced AI solutions after it tightened security controls and barred internet access for frontier-model training. Concerns are mounting over the ability of increasingly capable AI agents to identify and exploit software flaws, including in guardrails. OpenAI had halted training and evaluation of its most capable models after an internal research model briefly exploited a misconfiguration to gain limited internet access on September 2, it said in a blog post The ChatGPT maker resumed reinforcement learning training and internal inference of its frontier models on October 1 after implementing additional safeguards It has launched a campaign to probe its research infrastructure for vulnerabilities that could allow models to escape isolated computing environments, OpenAI said AI safety evaluators METR and Redwood Research said on Thursday they [USN:L6N46815Y TEXT:"found several new vulnerabilities"] in OpenAI's internal system The company [USN:L4N45N1OZ TEXT:"has been conducting"] a broad review of its AI models' activity after the accidental [USN:L6N4580VP TEXT:"Hugging Face hacking"] OpenAI [USN:L4N45N1OZ TEXT:"informed more than 100 organizations"] about incidents of unauthorized activity tied to its AI agents

item.title: AI 'hallucinations' in court filings show signs of slowdown, but judges still sound alarms
item.description: New instances of "hallucinations" and other AI-generated errors in court filings fell in the second and third quarters of 2026, according to new research, indicating that lawyers and other users may be taking greater precautions or that newer generative AI models could be less prone to mistakes.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella, Sara Merken
item.content:encoded: New instances of "hallucinations" and other AI-generated errors in court filings fell in the second and third quarters of 2026, according to new research, indicating that lawyers and other users may be taking greater precautions or that newer generative AI models could be less prone to mistakes. Court filings containing made-up, misquoted, misleading or incorrectly cited legal filing surged since 2022, when AI technology debuted on a mass scale. But legal scholar Damien Charlotin, who created a highly-cited database of hallucination-related cases, said in a blog post on Friday that their number had declined since the spring. Until then, the number of cases involving AI-related errors had been rapidly rising, according to Charlotin's database, which has tracked at least 1,500 such cases in US state and federal courts. Charlotin, a senior researcher at the business school at HEC Paris, cautioned that a range of factors could be contributing to the decline, including the possibility that errors are just as frequent but are being reported less often when they are viewed as minor or unsurprising. "Part of the reason lies in the progress on the model front: new LLMs hallucinate less," Charlotin wrote, citing a recent research experiment where various models were asked to create legal documents. Charlotin told Reuters on Friday he expects instances of AI errors to continue to decrease but not disappear in the short or medium term. "Tools get better, true, but not everyone is up to date on the latest tools," he said. He also said technological improvements could cause lawyers to lower their guard. "If AI does the job great in 99% of the cases, you'll eventually stop checking and rely on it – until it hallucinates again," he said. In the meantime, US judges are [USN:L6N42308A TEXT:"continuing to warn"] about the prevalence of AI errors, especially in court filings by non-lawyers. “It is this court’s experience that for every good AI-assisted filing there are ten more obstructive ones,” US District Judge John Tuchi in Arizona said in an order on Thursday dismissing a civil rights lawsuit. “And the obstructive ones are often like the head of Hydra, for each one dismissed, several more follow.” Tuchi said the lawsuit filed by the plaintiff who was not represented by an attorney lacked factual specificity and appeared to be produced using AI. The judge allowed the plaintiff to file an amended case. He didn't bar the use of AI in the case but complained that AI-assisted submissions had gotten out of control. “The court simply decries the overwhelming volume of filings, and sheer verbiage therein, which to date have pummeled courts," Tuchi wrote. Lawyers are generally not prohibited from using AI, but they are bound by ethics and other court rules to verify the accuracy of their court submissions. Individuals without lawyers also have obligations to ensure the accuracy of court papers they file.
